posts.name: Ahsan Tareen
posts.cooked:
Hi @Mubasher

Direct PDF editing inside ERPNext is not Logical and would require custom development. The closest native approach is to use dynamic print formats with conditional logic to hide or show fields before generating the PDF.

it’s not possible by default due to several reasons;

  1. PDFs are static and once a print format is generated, it’s rendered as a fixed PDF file. Frappe uses wkhtmltopdf to convert HTML-based print formats into PDFs, which means there’s no interactive editor built in.
  2. Security & audit trail as ERPNext is designed to maintain data integrity. Allowing direct PDF editing would create data mismatch issues between what’s stored in ERPNext and what’s on the printed document.
  3. Once you are in PDF environment, you are no more within ERPNext interaction and can not be controlled for any further addition or editing.
